Thanks for the quick follow up. Wed morning would be tight for us; Thu 7/23 8:30–9:10am PDT works best.

A few details up front so you can size the call:
- Peak reqs: ~1,200 qps for short bursts (1–2 min), sustained 200–300 qps during workday peaks.
- Latency target: 95th ≤ 120ms for 512-token requests (we can tolerate graceful degradation).
- Typical payload: 512–1,024 tokens, batching preferred if latency stays acceptable.
- Security: We prefer VPC deployment or private connectivity; will need KMS integration.

I’m attaching a quick export of our current traffic sample. Hope that helps.
